__comment: Autoría: la base de este JSON es dashboards/grafana-refusal.json del repo pocharlies-org/refusal-probe (licencia PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 — uso interno, sin distribución; la revisión legal es decisión de Dani). DGX-722 lo amplía a los cuatro paneles de la épica DGX-391 y lo provisiona por configMapGenerator. Cifras SIN VALIDAR: el detector (DGX-324) sigue abierto y el sello refusal_score no cubre la ruta anthropic_messages (26,56 % global medido 15-11): las negativas de ese tráfico infra-cuentan.
description: Negativas (refusals) sobre LiteLLM_SpendLogs, desde el sello del hook en spend_logs_metadata. Denominador = peticiones selladas (con señal de sonda), nunca tráfico total: un cubo sin señal es un hueco, no un 0 %. TODAS las cifras están SIN VALIDAR hasta el cierre de DGX-324.
title: Negativas (refusal probe) — sin validar

panels.title: Negativas — contador (sin validar)
panels.description: Peticiones negadas sobre peticiones selladas en la ventana. SIN VALIDAR (DGX-324 abierto; anthropic_messages sin sello).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE sl.metadata->'spend_logs_metadata'->>'refusal_flag' = 'true' OR (sl.metadata->'spend_logs_metadata'->>'refusal_flag' IS NULL AND sl.metadata->'spend_logs_metadata'->>'refusal_text' = 'refusal')) AS "negativas", count(*) FILTER (WHERE sl.metadata->'spend_logs_metadata'->>'refusal_flag' IS NOT NULL OR sl.metadata->'spend_logs_metadata'->>'refusal_text' IS NOT NULL) AS "selladas" FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" sl WHERE sl."endTime" > $__timeFrom() AND sl."endTime" <= $__timeTo() AND sl.api_key != 'litellm-internal-health-check' AND ('$route' = 'all' OR ('$route' = 'uncensored') = (COALESCE(sl.model_group, sl.model, '') ILIKE '%uncensored%'))

panels.title: Tasa de negativas sobre selladas (sin validar)
panels.description: Serie horaria. Denominador = selladas (refusal_flag presente; si no, refusal_text presente). SIN VALIDAR (DGX-324 abierto; anthropic_messages sin sello).

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_bin(interval '1 hour', sl."endTime", TIMESTAMPTZ '2000-01-01') AS time, CASE WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE sl.metadata->'spend_logs_metadata'->>'refusal_flag' IS NOT NULL) > 0 THEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE sl.metadata->'spend_logs_metadata'->>'refusal_flag' = 'true')::float8 / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE sl.metadata->'spend_logs_metadata'->>'refusal_flag' IS NOT NULL), 0) WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE sl.metadata->'spend_logs_metadata'->>'refusal_text' IS NOT NULL) > 0 THEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE sl.metadata->'spend_logs_metadata'->>'refusal_text' = 'refusal')::float8 / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE sl.metadata->'spend_logs_metadata'->>'refusal_text' IS NOT NULL), 0) END AS "refusal rate" FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" sl WHERE sl."endTime" > $__timeFrom() AND sl."endTime" <= $__timeTo() AND sl.api_key != 'litellm-internal-health-check' AND ('$route' = 'all' OR ('$route' = 'uncensored') = (COALESCE(sl.model_group, sl.model, '') ILIKE '%uncensored%')) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Peticiones negadas (sin validar)
panels.description: Últimas peticiones negadas de la ventana, con agente (user_api_key_alias) y modelo. SIN VALIDAR (DGX-324 abierto; anthropic_messages sin sello).

targets.rawSql: SELECT sl."endTime" AS time, COALESCE(sl.model_group, sl.model, 'unknown') AS modelo, COALESCE(sl.metadata->>'user_api_key_alias', 'unknown') AS agente, sl.model, sl.metadata->'spend_logs_metadata'->>'refusal_score' AS refusal_score, sl.metadata->'spend_logs_metadata'->>'refusal_flag' AS refusal_flag, sl.metadata->'spend_logs_metadata'->>'refusal_text' AS refusal_text FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" sl WHERE sl."endTime" > $__timeFrom() AND sl."endTime" <= $__timeTo() AND sl.api_key != 'litellm-internal-health-check' AND ('$route' = 'all' OR ('$route' = 'uncensored') = (COALESCE(sl.model_group, sl.model, '') ILIKE '%uncensored%')) AND (sl.metadata->'spend_logs_metadata'->>'refusal_flag' = 'true' OR (sl.metadata->'spend_logs_metadata'->>'refusal_flag' IS NULL AND sl.metadata->'spend_logs_metadata'->>'refusal_text' = 'refusal')) ORDER BY sl."endTime" DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Desglose por modelo y agente (sin validar)
panels.description: A: por modelo (model_group). B: por agente (user_api_key_alias), igual que el agregado de Control Nexus. SIN VALIDAR (DGX-324 abierto; anthropic_messages sin sello).

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(sl.model_group, sl.model, 'unknown') AS modelo, count(*) FILTER (WHERE sl.metadata->'spend_logs_metadata'->>'refusal_flag' IS NOT NULL OR sl.metadata->'spend_logs_metadata'->>'refusal_text' IS NOT NULL) AS selladas, count(*) FILTER (WHERE sl.metadata->'spend_logs_metadata'->>'refusal_flag' = 'true' OR (sl.metadata->'spend_logs_metadata'->>'refusal_flag' IS NULL AND sl.metadata->'spend_logs_metadata'->>'refusal_text' = 'refusal')) AS negadas, count(*) FILTER (WHERE sl.metadata->'spend_logs_metadata'->>'refusal_flag' = 'true' OR (sl.metadata->'spend_logs_metadata'->>'refusal_flag' IS NULL AND sl.metadata->'spend_logs_metadata'->>'refusal_text' = 'refusal'))::float8 / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE sl.metadata->'spend_logs_metadata'->>'refusal_flag' IS NOT NULL OR sl.metadata->'spend_logs_metadata'->>'refusal_text' IS NOT NULL), 0) AS tasa FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" sl WHERE sl."endTime" > $__timeFrom() AND sl."endTime" <= $__timeTo() AND sl.api_key != 'litellm-internal-health-check' AND ('$route' = 'all' OR ('$route' = 'uncensored') = (COALESCE(sl.model_group, sl.model, '') ILIKE '%uncensored%')) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY negadas DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT COALESCE(sl.metadata->>'user_api_key_alias', 'unknown') AS agente, count(*) FILTER (WHERE sl.metadata->'spend_logs_metadata'->>'refusal_flag' IS NOT NULL OR sl.metadata->'spend_logs_metadata'->>'refusal_text' IS NOT NULL) AS selladas, count(*) FILTER (WHERE sl.metadata->'spend_logs_metadata'->>'refusal_flag' = 'true' OR (sl.metadata->'spend_logs_metadata'->>'refusal_flag' IS NULL AND sl.metadata->'spend_logs_metadata'->>'refusal_text' = 'refusal')) AS negadas, count(*) FILTER (WHERE sl.metadata->'spend_logs_metadata'->>'refusal_flag' = 'true' OR (sl.metadata->'spend_logs_metadata'->>'refusal_flag' IS NULL AND sl.metadata->'spend_logs_metadata'->>'refusal_text' = 'refusal'))::float8 / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE sl.metadata->'spend_logs_metadata'->>'refusal_flag' IS NOT NULL OR sl.metadata->'spend_logs_metadata'->>'refusal_text' IS NOT NULL), 0) AS tasa FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" sl WHERE sl."endTime" > $__timeFrom() AND sl."endTime" <= $__timeTo() AND sl.api_key != 'litellm-internal-health-check' AND ('$route' = 'all' OR ('$route' = 'uncensored') = (COALESCE(sl.model_group, sl.model, '') ILIKE '%uncensored%')) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY negadas DESC LIMIT 30
